title: 第十四章 日常总是源于柴米油盐
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

渚琰·工藤新一被抽了好多血，除了血常规以外还有查肝功、查肾功、血气分析……此外还有尿检。

当然，本来就没吃什么神秘小药丸的工藤新一，并没有查出任何问题。只是白细胞和中性粒细胞的计数上升了一倍，不过那只是头上挨那一棍子的功劳。

不过检查是有用的，至少让一直忧心忡忡的小兰放心了一些。还让柯南对他自己的身体情况疑神疑鬼起来。

离开医院时，柯南还在捧着工藤新一的血常规报告横看竖看。

可惜这上面没有检验血型……柯南心想，不过他也没抱太大希望，毕竟黑衣人的同伙连阿笠博士的屁股都调查清楚了，工藤新一的血型算不上什么机密。

离开医院后，他们去了百货超市，添置小兰和柯南所需要的生活用品，还有午餐需要的食材。

“这个怎么样？正好我也想把我的漱口杯换一下。”工藤新一从日用品的货架上取下一件商品。

穿原版工藤新一的衣服没问题，但用原版工藤新一的牙刷、水杯等等东西，渚琰还是有些芥蒂的。

他手中的包装里有两个漱口杯，材质是比较厚实的塑料，一个是粉色一个是蓝色，杯子上有卡通图案，不过要把两个杯子靠在一起，图案才能拼合完整。

任谁看了都能明白，这是情侣款。

推着购物车的小兰，偏头看见了工藤新一手里的东西，司马昭之心路人皆知。不过小兰首先关注了一下价格，便有了拒绝的借口：

“像这种材质的漱口杯一般不到三百円，新一你挑的这两个加一起要八百円，不划算啦。”

小兰表示拒绝被割智商税，从工藤新一的手里拿走了那件套装，又放回在货架上。

只不过在放回去之前，小兰又多打量了一眼杯子上面的图案。其实她也心动了，只是不好意思用情侣杯。

工藤新一的嘴角露出计划得逞的笑容：“那这个量贩装呢？只要六百円，三个杯子还送三支牙刷。”

他拿起了另一个套装，里面有两大一小三个杯子，分别是天蓝色、粉红色和一个小号的紫色漱口杯，都是纯色的没有图案，还有三支同色的牙刷。

这是为一家三口设计的量贩装。工藤新一低头，搓了搓柯南狗头：“刚好给这个小鬼头用这个淡紫儿的。”

“这个……”小兰犹豫了。

注意到工藤新一的奸笑，柯南的神情凝固：这家伙……有阴谋啊！先给小兰看了对小兰来说比较‘刺激’的情侣款，再看到没有图案、只是款式相同的家庭款就没那么大的抵触心理了。而且小兰刚刚才用了价格不划算这个理由拒绝了，现在这个比较实惠的套装让她没有拒绝的借口啊。

在抬头仔细看小兰的表情——小兰根本不需要拒绝的借口，她很心动啊！

但是用这套漱口杯的话，那个冒牌货和小兰用着同样的款式，而我就相当于他们的儿子了？我不要啊！

“这个杯子好丑啊！”柯南大叫起来：“我不要这个杯子！我要更酷——的！”

“也行，那就单独给你买一个儿童款……可惜没有福尔摩斯主题的，不然我也会想要一个的。”工藤新一难得惯着柯南一次，立刻答应了柯南，来到儿童用品这边，打量着那些花花绿绿的卡通造型。

柯南差点赞同的点点头，及时反应了过来：“我不要福尔摩斯的，我要暗夜男爵的！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A lot of blood was drawn from Nagisa Yan and Kudo Shinichi. In addition to routine blood tests, liver function tests, kidney function tests, blood gas analysis... and urine tests were also performed.

Of course, Kudo Shinichi, who had never taken any mysterious pills, did not find any problems.Only the count of white blood cells and neutrophils doubled, but that was just the result of the stick on the head.

However, the inspection was useful, and at least it made Xiaolan, who had been worried, feel relieved.It also made Conan suspicious of his own physical condition.

When leaving the hospital, Conan was still holding Kudo Shinichi's blood routine report and looking at it sideways and vertically.

It's a pity that there is no blood type test... Conan thought to himself, but he didn't hold out much hope. After all, the associates of the man in black had even investigated Dr. Agasa's ass, and Kudo Shinichi's blood type was not a secret.

After leaving the hospital, they went to the department store to buy the daily necessities needed by Xiaolan and Conan, as well as the ingredients for lunch.

"How about this? I just want to change my mouthwash cup." Kudo Shinichi took down an item from the daily necessities shelf.

There is no problem wearing original Kudo Shinichi's clothes, but Nagisa still has some grudges about using original Kudo Shinichi's toothbrushes, water bottles, etc.

There are two mouthwash cups in the package in his hand. They are made of relatively thick plastic, one is pink and the other is blue. There are cartoon patterns on the cups, but the two cups need to be brought together to make the patterns complete.

Anyone who sees it can understand that this is a couple's model.

Xiaolan, who was pushing the shopping cart, turned her head and saw what was in Kudo Shinichi's hand. Sima Zhao's heart was obvious to all passersby.However, Xiaolan first paid attention to the price and then had an excuse to refuse:

"A mouthwash cup made of this kind of material usually costs less than 300 yen. The two you picked out, Shinichi, cost 800 yen together. It's not a good deal."

Xiaolan expressed her refusal to be cut off from the IQ tax, took the suit from Kudo Shinichi, and put it back on the shelf.

But before putting it back, Xiaolan took another look at the pattern on the cup.In fact, she was also moved, but she was too embarrassed to use the couple cup.

Kudo Shinichi's lips showed a smile of success: "What about this mass-market package? It's only 600 yen, and three cups come with three toothbrushes."

He picked up another set, which contained three cups, two large and one small. They were sky blue, pink and a small purple mouthwash cup. They were all solid colors without patterns, and three toothbrushes of the same color.

This is a mass-market outfit designed for a family of three.Kudo Shinichi lowered his head and rubbed Conan's head: "I just used this lavender one for this little devil."

"This..." Xiaolan hesitated.

Noticing Kudo Shinichi's evil smile, Conan's expression froze: This guy...has a conspiracy!I first showed Xiaolan the couple’s model which was more ‘exciting’ for Xiaolan, and then I saw the family model with no pattern and just the same style, so I didn’t feel so resistant.Moreover, Xiaolan just used the reason that the price was not cost-effective to refuse. Now this relatively affordable set gives her no excuse to refuse.

Looking up at Xiaolan's expression carefully - Xiaolan doesn't need an excuse to refuse, she is very excited!

But with this set of mouthwash cups, the counterfeit and Xiaolan use the same style, and I am equivalent to their son?I don’t want it!

"This cup is so ugly!" Conan shouted: "I don't want this cup! I want something cooler!"

"Okay, then I will buy you a children's model separately... It's a pity that there is no Sherlock Holmes theme, otherwise I would also want one." Kudo Shinichi rarely spoiled Conan for once, and immediately agreed to Conan, and came to the children's products, looking at the colorful cartoon shapes.

Conan almost nodded in agreement and reacted in time: "I don't want Holmes's, I want the Night Baron's!"
